newsitem.title: USA: Parker Drilling to buy Hercules Rig, Offshore.
newsitem.headline: Parker Drilling to buy Hercules Rig, Offshore.

text.p: Parker Drilling Co. said Friday it has definitive agreements to acquire Hercules Offshore Corp. and Hercules Rig Corp. for $195 million.

Hercules Offshore Corp., a Houston-based offshore drilling contractor, is owned by Trenergy (Malaysia) Bhd. Hercules owns seven jackup rigs and three self-erecting platform rigs in the Gulf of Mexico, Parker said.

"This acquisition is consistent with, and continues Parker Drilling's overall strategy to acquire leading companies in active, niche offshore markets," said Robert Parker Jr., president and chief executive.
"Hercules is a strategic addition to our existing offshore, land drilling and rental tool businesses."
Parker, an international drilling contractor based in Tulsa, Okla., said closing of the deal is subject to financing and Trenergy obtaining the approvals by stockholders and Malaysian regulators.
